subject: BUILD 2: ready-only-via-judged — close the native-adoption bypass so NO node reaches ready/dispatch un-judged
description: With BUILD 1 every newly-seen task gets autowire candidate edges + a judgingSince anchor at birth, so daemon.js effective() (the existing D-gate at daemon.js:1350-1351, judge.judgingState) will now hold native/adopted/file-drop/follow-up tasks in the judging phase until their edges are judged (eager path C) or the timeout fires (provisional fallback). Also fold follow-up creation (lib/followups.js apply, ~line 85-96 — setSnapshot + addEdge, today NO embed/autowire/eager) through ingestNode so follow-ups stop bypassing too. Depends on BUILD 1. status: pending.
